name: code
description: Source code with a light syntax tint (keywords, strings, comments), line numbers and lit focus lines.

lang.description: py | go | ts (js and others tint like ts) | sh (bash, zsh, just, make) | text (no tint)

focus.description: line numbers to light (as numbered, i.e. counting from start)

title.description: file name or caption in the header

example.title: grow.py
example.code:
def grow(p, r, n):
    return p * (1 + r) ** n
